Good afternoon. Can I help you find anything?
Yes, please. I need a jacket for the evening. Do you have this one in a large?
Here you are, on the hanger. The fitting room is on your right.
Thank you. Hmm. It's too big, and the sleeves are too long. It's very loose here.
I see. Let me bring you a medium. It's a little more tight on the arms.
This one is perfect. It isn't too tight, and the sleeves are long enough. Is it cotton?
Yes, one hundred percent cotton, and completely plain. That dark blue really suits you.

Good afternoon, and welcome to our store. Today is a special day for jackets and shirts. All our cotton shirts are on the second floor, next to the fitting rooms. If a shirt is too tight or too loose, please ask one of our assistants: we can bring you another size in two minutes. Please remember to put each item back on the hanger before you leave the fitting room. If the sleeves are not long enough for you, we can also show you a longer model. Our plain shirts are near the window, and they suit almost everybody. Thank you for shopping with us, and have a wonderful afternoon.

Yesterday I walked to a small store near my hotel. I wanted a jacket for the evening, because the weather was cold. The first jacket was too big for me: the sleeves were too long, and it was very loose on the shoulders. The shop assistant was kind, and she offered me a medium. The medium was not too tight, and the sleeves were long enough. It was one hundred percent cotton, in a plain dark blue, with no pattern at all. I looked in the mirror and I thought: this really suits me. Then I paid, I put my old jacket in the bag, and I walked back to the hotel. I did all of it in English, and I did not use my phone once.

First, Roberto walks into the store and looks at the jackets. Then he asks the shop assistant for a large. Next, he takes the jacket to the fitting room and tries it on. After that, he says the jacket is too big and the sleeves are too long. Finally, he tries a medium, and this one is long enough, so he buys it.
